name: 나라 선택
description: 나라별로 평야·숲·구릉·담수를 조합하고, 특화 지형은 자연스럽게 이어집니다.
prompt:
Refine the attached TownGrid COUNTRY-SELECTION mockup. The user likes this composition and minimal UI; preserve its identity, Korean typography, dark teal #193f42, cream and orange #ee701b, fixed isometric quarter view, recognizable selected "에스테른 왕국" center-left, the broad river network, political outlines and country-name placement. One 16:9 full-bleed polished game-screen mockup, not an infographic, no collage, no decorative frame. Keep crisp pixel game art, not smooth 3D or watercolor.

Two issues must be solved with convincing visible design:

1. REGIONAL DIVERSITY / GAMEPLAY BALANCE. Land biomes must NOT coincide with country borders. There must be no whole ochre desert nation, solid forest nation, blank grass nation, or all-dark hostile nation. Blend natural connected terrain within each nation rather than scattering unrelated patches:
- In selected central "에스테른 왕국", show broad usable meadow together with two modest woodland groves, one low rocky hill ridge, and a tributary or small freshwater pond. The open grass occupies about half of this nation, not 90 percent.
- At southwest "오르벨 왕국", replace MOST of the giant uninterrupted sand plateau with semi-arid golden grassland, green river valley terraces and a few small oasis basins. True sand remains in only a few contiguous rain-shadow pockets, with shrubs, rocks and gradual transitions. It is still an arid region, but a readable varied place, not a solid orange block.
- At west "실바엔 숲공국", break the dense forest with coherent broad clearings, a stream and a modest rocky upland; forest groves about half, not wall-to-wall trees.
- At northwest "카르둠 산악공국", mountain ranges are short, broken by spacious green valleys, meadows and freshwater. Snow only on high summits.
- At northeast "네자르 마도국", reduce the black barren area to a small volcanic/mineral enclave; add normal upland grass and small woods around it. Being hostile does not make every tile sterile.
- East "아르셀 연방" and "브로덴 철도시" get a mix of grassy hills, woodland, useful riverbanks and a few small dry basins. Keep their distinctive city icons small.
- The forests, rivers and low ridges CROSS national borders naturally; political borders are not biome boundaries.
- Preserve meaningful unclaimed land between some borders. Rare desert/oil/volcanic terrain stays localized. Do not give every country every terrain, do not create a checkerboard patchwork, do not distribute snow in lowland plains. Water remains under 20 percent of visible scene. No huge ocean.
- Keep the imagery calm and coarse enough to read at overview. Fewer decorative trees/rocks and tiny repetitive icons than the reference. Use large coherent ground-color masses with transition bands.

2. WORLD EDGE DESIGN. The actual playable atlas has a finite grid, but its world must not look like a cut-out diamond or float in a void. Outside selectable ground there is a generous, NONSELECTABLE landscape continuation belt: valleys, woods, streams and low ridges continue naturally past the selectable area. Farther scenery has reduced saturation and contrast with a very slight atmospheric veil. There is NO visible hard rectangular cut, no sheer continuous cliff, no ring of mountain-wall, and no ocean moat surrounding the map. The decorative land goes beyond the camera footprint in all directions. Pixel art extends to all four image edges. Camera bounds keep the true texture edge outside the viewport. Do not depict an arbitrary frame or fog line on a political border.

UI unchanged from reference: top-left back button and "어디에서 시작할까요?" with small "지도에서 나라를 고르세요"; top-right "지형으로 찾기"; bottom-center low flat dark-teal strip "에스테른 왕국", small "평야 · 숲 · 하천", orange "지역 살펴보기 →"; bottom-right small plus/minus. No extra settings, help card, resources or overlay explaining this design.
VIEW A — REVISED OVERVIEW. Show the same recognizable broad country overview and camera placement as the attached image, with the improvements above. The outermost 8-12% of the top/left corners subtly suggests subdued landscape continuation beyond the mapped countries, still rendered as readable terrain, NOT blank white fog. Do not make the screen look heavily vignetted. The main proof is the visible mixed terrain: the southwest is no longer a solid desert and central plains have woods/hills/water. Preserve exactly one highlighted central nation and a clear minimalist interface.

name: 외곽으로 이동
description: 선택 영역 밖에도 지형을 이어 그리고, 카메라는 바깥 지형의 끝에 닿기 전에 멈춥니다.
